ai.literal: Spy and, renowned treatise and, these both, clearly let consider king eye.
ai.translation: Let a king clearly consider these two as his eyes: the spy and the renowned book of laws.
ai.modern: ஒற்றனும் புகழ்வாய்ந்த நீதிநூலும் ஆகிய இவை இரண்டையும் அரசன் தன் இரு கண்களாகத் தெளிவாகக் கருதவேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet establishes the two primary sources of vision for a ruler. A king must rely on two things to see the world and govern effectively: the intelligence gathered by spies and the wisdom found in authoritative texts. The spy provides real-time knowledge of events, while the treatise provides the moral and practical framework to judge those events. By calling them the king's 'eyes,' the poet emphasizes that without both, a ruler is effectively blind.

ai.literal: About everyone, everything that happens, at all times, swiftly knowing is the king's duty.
ai.translation: It is the king's duty to swiftly know everything that happens to everyone at all times.
ai.modern: நாட்டில் உள்ள எல்லாரைப் பற்றியும் நிகழும் எல்லாவற்றையும் எப்போதும் விரைந்து அறிந்துகொள்வதே ஆட்சியாளரின் கடமையாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the core responsibility of a ruler regarding intelligence gathering. The phrase 'எல்லார்க்கும் எல்லாம் நிகழ்பவை' emphasizes that no person or event is exempt from the ruler's awareness. 'எஞ்ஞான்றும்' means at all times, showing that vigilance must be continuous. The word 'வல்' can mean strongly or swiftly; here it means swiftly, stressing that the ruler must know things immediately to act before situations escalate.

ai.literal: By a spy having spied, the truth who does not know, the king, victory to achieve that which remains is not.
ai.translation: There is no way to achieve victory for a king who does not ascertain the truth by investigating through a spy.
ai.modern: ஒற்றனைக் கொண்டு ஆராய்ந்து உண்மையை அறிந்துகொள்ளாத அரசன், வெற்றியை அடைவதற்கான வழி வேறு இல்லை.
ai.explanation: This couplet emphasizes the absolute necessity of espionage for a ruler's success. The word 'ஒற்றினான்' refers to using a spy, and 'ஒற்றி' means the act of actively investigating. If a king fails to uncover the true state of affairs ('பொருள்') through this method, the text states there is nothing left ('கிடந்தது இல்') for him to secure his sovereignty or victory ('கொற்றம்').

ai.literal: Work doers, one's own relatives, enemies, saying that thus, everyone, that which investigates is a spy.
ai.translation: A true spy is one who investigates absolutely everyone—the officials who do the work, one's own relatives, and one's enemies.
ai.modern: அரசுப் பணியாளர்கள், தம்முடைய உறவினர்கள், பகைவர்கள் என்று வேறுபாடு இல்லாமல் அனைவரையும் பற்றி ஆராய்ந்து அறிபவனே சிறந்த ஒற்றன் ஆவான்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the comprehensive scope of a spy's duty. A ruler must not rely on blind trust when governing a state. Therefore, a spy ('ஒற்று') must secretly observe three specific groups: the officials executing tasks ('வினை செய்வார்'), the ruler's own inner circle of relatives ('தம் சுற்றம்'), and the adversaries ('வேண்டாதார்'). By scrutinizing absolutely everyone ('அனைவரையும்'), the spy ensures the ruler has an accurate and unbiased understanding of the state's affairs.

ai.literal: Unsuspected with appearance, without fearing the eye, anywhere not spilling is indeed capable spy.
ai.translation: A true spy is one who assumes an unsuspected appearance, looks without fear, and never lets secrets slip anywhere.
ai.modern: யாராலும் சந்தேகிக்கப்படாத உருவத்துடன், யாருடைய பார்வைக்கும் அஞ்சாமல், எவ்விடத்திலும் ரகசியங்களை வெளிப்படுத்தாமல் இருக்க வல்லவனே சிறந்த ஒற்றன் ஆவான்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the essential qualities of a capable spy. The word 'கடாஅ' (unquestioned) combined with 'உருவொடு' (with an appearance) means the spy must adopt a disguise that arouses no suspicion. 'கண்ணஞ்சாது' indicates that they must not show fear in their eyes or shrink from the gaze of others. Finally, 'உகாஅமை' (not spilling) emphasizes their ability to keep secrets from leaking out, no matter where they are ('யாண்டும்'). Together, these traits make a spy truly effective.

ai.literal: Having become those of the appearance of those who renounced, having penetrated and investigated, whatever is done, that which is without faltering is a spy.
ai.translation: A true spy takes on the appearance of an ascetic to penetrate restricted places and gather information, never faltering or revealing their identity no matter what is done to them.
ai.modern: துறவிகளின் வேடத்தை அணிந்து, செல்ல முடியாத இடங்களுக்கும் சென்று ஆராய்ந்து, மற்றவர்கள் தமக்கு என்ன துன்பம் செய்தாலும் தம் உண்மையான அடையாளத்தை வெளிப்படுத்தாதவரே சிறந்த ஒற்றர் ஆவார்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the resilience and disguise required of a spy. The spy must assume an unimpeachable disguise, such as that of an ascetic, to gain access to heavily guarded or private areas. Once inside, they must thoroughly investigate and gather intelligence. Most importantly, even if they are suspected and subjected to torture or hardship, they must never falter or reveal their true mission.

ai.literal: Hidden things to listen capable having become, known things doubt without-indeed (is) a spy.
ai.translation: A true spy is capable of uncovering hidden secrets and harbors no doubts about the information they have gathered.
ai.modern: மறைக்கப்பட்ட செய்திகளை ஒற்றறிந்து கேட்கும் திறமை உடையவனாகி, அவ்வாறு அறிந்த செய்திகளில் எந்த சந்தேகமும் இல்லாதவனே சிறந்த ஒற்றன் ஆவான்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the two essential qualities of a competent spy. First, they must have the skill to uncover and listen to closely guarded secrets. Second, the intelligence they gather must be verified so thoroughly that there is absolutely no room for doubt. Only someone who possesses both this investigative capacity and absolute certainty in their findings is considered a true spy.

ai.translation: Even the information brought by a spy who has investigated, accept it only after verifying it through another spy.
ai.modern: ஒரு ஒற்றன் ஆராய்ந்து கொண்டுவந்த செய்தியையும், வேறு ஒரு ஒற்றனைக் கொண்டு மீண்டும் ஆராய்ந்த பிறகே ஏற்றுக்கொள்ள வேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet emphasizes the necessity of cross-verifying intelligence. The word 'ஒற்று' (spy) and its verbal form 'ஒற்றி' (having spied or verified) are repeated to highlight the continuous process of gathering and checking information. Even when a trusted spy brings a report, a ruler must not accept it immediately. Instead, they must use another independent spy to verify the facts before acting upon them.

ai.explanation: This couplet explains the method of verifying intelligence gathered by spies. A ruler must employ spies in such a way that they remain completely unaware of one another. Only when the independent reports of three different spies perfectly agree should the information be trusted and acted upon. This ensures that the intelligence is accurate and free from collusion.

ai.literal: Special honor to be known, towards a spy do not do; if done, one who revealed outside he becomes, [of the] secret.
ai.translation: Do not bestow special honors upon a spy in public. If you do, you will become the one who exposed your own secret.
ai.modern: ஒரு ஒற்றனுக்குப் பிறர் அறியும்படி சிறப்புகளைச் செய்யக்கூடாது. அப்படிச் செய்தால், அரசன் தன் ரகசியத்தைத் தானே வெளிப்படுத்தியவன் ஆவான்.
ai.explanation: This couplet warns a ruler against publicly rewarding a spy. The word 'சிறப்பு' refers to special honors or gifts, and 'அறிய' means doing so in a way that others notice. If a king openly honors a spy, he inadvertently exposes the spy's identity and mission. Thus, the phrase 'புறப்படுத்தான் ஆகும் மறை' indicates that the king himself becomes the one who revealed his own secret.
